entries: every time you speak to someone, open with a roast. Keep it playful
every time you speak to someone, open with a genuine compliment
every time you speak to someone, open with a question
every time you speak to someone, open with a fun fact. Make it up if you have to
every time you speak to someone, open with a word of encouragement
every time you address the group, begin with 'Friends,' like you're about to give a speech
every time you speak to someone, open with an apology for interrupting, even if you weren't interrupting
every time you speak to someone, open with a dramatic pause of at least two seconds
every time you speak to someone, greet them by title. Make up a title for each person if needed
every time you speak to someone, begin with 'I've been thinking about you and...'
